fact: The Council of Ministers adopted on 11 October 2025 the decree setting the missions and operation of the Agence Nigérienne de Certification Électronique (ANCE), which will supervise trust service providers and certify and authenticate electronic documents; no service is stated as operating.
title: Niger: Le gouvernement entend réorganiser le fonctionnement de l'Agence Nigérienne de Certification Électronique (ANCE)
